typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You lost your phone and you had absolutely no idea where it went.*
*You could've sworn you have seen e/n, your roommate, holding it a few minutes ago.*

*You took a deep breath and knew that he wasn't going to listen anyway,so you barged into his room and yelled at him.*
"Where did you put my
phone?"

*Your eyes widened when he turned around, shirtless.*
"What are you talking
about?"
*You stared at his abs for a solid five seconds.*

"Take a picture, I'll last longer" *You snapped out of it when you heard his voice.*

"Well I can't because you took my phone"

"I don't have your phone y/n" *he rolled his eyes.*
*You took a deep breath and knew that he wasn't going to listen anyway, so you checked for your phone in your room but couldn't find it.*

*When you came back in the living room, your phone was suddenly on the coffee table.*
*You quickly grabbed it and went through it to make sure everything was alright.*

*You swiped through your camera roll and found pictures of e/n's abs that he took..*
